policy: References are source-page photo examples for the precise indexed action, not locally hosted gameplay screenshots. Links stay on publisher domains; no copying, hotlinking or license inference. Publisher headings are provided to locate an image on the original page. Where a source does not document a specific image, no photo link is added. Visual examples for meditation and Randy's wish list come from Push Square and must not be represented as guaranteed spawn evidence.
